sections.text: Introduction

The 
GSCT 12X1 relay with an internal phase angle can be used as earth fault 
protection in non compensated networks, but it can be also as a reverse power 
under certain circumstance

Since this relay reacts to the real mean value of 
A.C. components (voltage & current) with the ferro dynamic element a torque can 
be produced only if both current & voltage contain the same basic or harmonic 
frequency

This procedure details the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the 
relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases. The 
document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing 
personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed 
 Bahie Abdel-Wanes, accepted by eng. Ragheb 
 Abd Raboh: general director, and approved by eng. Fathy 
 Mohamed Ibrahem: Head Sector of Siouf Power Station.

This document certified by 
eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer A and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Disconnected the 
circuit breaker before working

Remove the input 
current terminals number (1,2)

Remove the input 
voltage terminals number (4,5)

Connect test 
leads between the current terminals (1&2) and the voltage terminal (4&5)

Inject constant voltage 
of 100 V and increase the current slowly until the red indication on the relay 
appears

Record this 
value on the test sheet (adjust it if needed)

Switch off the 
set

sections.text: Time Test

Connect the time 
delayed contacts on the relay to timer terminals on the test set

Start the test 
by injecting the pick up current into the relay

Record the value 
of time on the test sheet (adjust it if needed)

The timer will 
stop once the relay has pick up

sections.text: Return Relay to Service

Disconnect the 
test leads from the terminal board and return the relay terminals (8,9) to 
normal condition

Disconnect the 
test leads from timer terminal on the relay and connect the relay time contact 
to normal condition

If any equipment 
associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by 
the following restoration steps
Breaker trip coil
